City of Encinitas
Special Joint City Council & Parks & Recreation Commission Meeting 4:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 25, 2024 -
04:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
CALL TO ORDER / ROLL CALL
City Council: Mayor Kranz, Deputy Mayor Blackwell, Council Members Ehlers, Hinze, and Lyndes
Parks & Recreation Commission: Chair Ridder, Vice Chair Hanson, Commissioners Capielo, Comorat, Evers, Quinn, and Van der Auwera
AGENDA ITEMS
1.
Special Joint Meeting of the City Council and Parks and Recreation Commission for the City Council to provide direction to the Parks and Recreation Commission to add to their work plan the goal of recommending a name and possible future uses for the City land located at the northeast corner of Highway 101 and La Costa Avenue. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Director Parks, Recreation and Cultural Arts Knopp

ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
